policy: Vendor-verbatim raw drops live only in these RESERVED subdir names inside a family dir. Their internal format is vendor property (DATA_PULL/DATA_CLEAN domain); the canonical date,<fields> contract applies to curated top-level family CSVs. Two-way fail-closed: unlisted raw dirs fail the layout test. R7 addition (DATA_ETF_MORE post-mortem, 2026-09-08): '_pit' is reserved for point-in-time vintage drops; ALFRED-style <SERIES_ID>/vintage.csv subdirs are ALSO legal via content classification in campaign/team/tests/test_data_layout.py (_pit_dirs: holds exactly vintage.csv in release-event schema) because renaming the series-ID dirs would break the verifiers that pin those paths.
